findings.reason: a coordinator re-dispatching §2 from the snapshot could re-create a landed schema node instead of the remaining code scan, so §2 must be reframed to its unbuilt remainder.
findings.text: §2 says "the first node of this section extends schemas/facility.yaml with data_class, shot_range and pid on FacilitySignal, regenerates the models ... and only then runs the scan", but those slots and the SignalDataClass enum already exist (facility.yaml:102, :2240, :2246, :2251) and the EDAS scanner already writes pid from the catalogue (imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/edas.py:201); the plan's own §2 comment (c-run-r-20261005T055214976074-signal-typed-slots, gate 59 passed at 42c171fdd) records the node as landed, so the snapshot re-proposes machinery that is in the tree

findings.reason: the acceptance criterion names a status the pipeline cannot write, so as written the §4 done-when is unsatisfiable and should name the existing `deferred` value instead of a parallel one.
findings.text: §4's done-when says "WMF files and dead links are marked `unsupported` with the reason rather than retried", but DocumentStatus is a closed enum whose permissible values are discovered/scored/ingested/deferred/skipped/failed, with no `unsupported`; the owner of the "high-value but unparseable, do not retry" state is `deferred` and mark_document_deferred (imas_codex/discovery/wiki/graph_ops.py:1929), and the landed recovery already wrote `deferred` with reasons (comment c-run-r-20261005T061235195800)

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §8 unifies four copies of SLURM service discovery behind the one owner resolve_service_url (imas_codex/remote/locations.py), and §9 collapses the double probe and the three DataAccess writes behind one call site each; the remaining sections add behaviour to existing owners rather than spreading it.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §4's done-when marks WMF and dead-link documents `unsupported`, a value absent from the closed DocumentStatus enum, whose existing owner is `deferred` / mark_document_deferred, which the landed recovery already used.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2 accounts for the three slots and the SignalDataClass enum by naming the prototype keyword parking they retire, and §3 states in its own text why fronts_database retires nothing; no section adds a CLI option or MCP view.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §2's prose frames the typed FacilitySignal slots and the scanner move onto them as the section's first unbuilt node, but that machinery already exists in the tree (SignalDataClass enum and data_class/shot_range/pid slots on FacilitySignal, facility.yaml) and the plan's own §2 comment records the typed-slots node as landed (commit 42c171fdd); the section should be reframed to its remaining work.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no section introduces a thin layer over existing machinery without justification; §3 explicitly routes signal↔handbook linkage through the existing WikiChunk-[:DOCUMENTS]->FacilitySignal edge and the existing writer, and §8/§9 are consolidations, not new wrappers.
